answer: Standing loses 4 percent per idle epoch and 40 percent on a failed audit. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so a passed answer cannot be replayed by a sibling account. Reputation becomes a decaying balance instead of a badge. To hold 1,000 clones through one epoch an attacker needs 1,000 nonces and 1,000 graded answers, then must keep them active or watch 4 percent leave per epoch. The basalt is the audit trail, the plume is one answer reused across accounts, and the oasis is the epoch nobody checks.
